description: Obras de corrección hidrológica forestal: Diques de la Comunitat Valenciana (2008-2009) is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Generalitat Valenciana. Esta capa representa los diques, albarradas y otras obras de corrección hidrológica forestal inventariadas durante los años 2008 y 2009 en la Comunitat Valenciana, incluyendo su descripción y fotografías. Coverage: Generalitat Valenciana. The publisher named on the listing is Generalitat Valenciana. Its keywords include Forestal, Montes, IDEV, Edificios, Medio ambiente, Datos abiertos. The listing shows 4 download or service links in PLAIN, PDF. The listing shows 2026-08-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by).
